text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono and I are visiting a shrine
at her
request.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh look, a bunch of stalls are set up!
Mmm, I can
smell the savory mochi balls
and full-bodied
amazake they're selling.
How lovely! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to! But let's do that later. I want
to pray
first.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've been feeling a little off lately, so
please help
me get my running back to
being buono!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono and I pray fervently
together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There, that should do it! I hope my
prayer's heard!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's go buy some mochi
balls—hm?

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Hup! Hmmm... Phew. These pilgrimage
stamp
books sure are heavy... Aaand
hup!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That shrine maiden looks like she's
struggling...
Wait here, Trainer! I'll be
right back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono jogs quickly over to the
shrine
maiden's side.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hello! If you'd like, I can help you carry
those!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your offer, but I can't
possibly
impose on a visitor who's come
to pray...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I just finished my prayers, actually!
Besides, I'd
feel bad if I just kept taking
without ever giving
anything in return.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I want to help others in their time of
need! Plus,
I'm really strong!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Well, in that case... Hehe. I'd be very
grateful for
your aid.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay! You can count on me! ☆

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! That was a huge
help!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome! Let me know if you
ever
need a hand again, because I'd be
more than
happy to help!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I worked up a great sweat, and I
think I feel
better now! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The heavens must've looked down
favorably upon
Hishi Akebono's
kindness, because she feels much
lighter
on her feet afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Raaah, hup!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. That was everything. Are you
all right,
though? You look a little pale...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Haha... I'm fine! In fact, I could
carry about a
million more loads!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono tries to reassure the
shrine maiden
with a smile, but her
exhaustion is clear as day.
And just after
she prayed to feel better too...
